// JAVASCRIPT UTILITY FUNCTIONS FOR COLOR MANAGEMENT
const colorUtilities = {
  // Get appropriate color based on NGSS component type
  getComponentColor: function(componentType) {
    const colorMap = {
      'practice': 'blue',
      'dci': 'orange', 
      'crosscutting': 'green',
      'metacognitive': 'purple'
    };
    return colorMap[componentType] || 'gray';
  },
  
  // Generate CSS classes for multi-component elements
  generateMultiColorClasses: function(components) {
    let classes = ['multi-component'];
    components.forEach(component => {
      classes.push(`has-${this.getComponentColor(component.type)}`);
    });
    return classes.join(' ');
  },
  
  // Create color-coded badges for NGSS components
  createNGSSBadge: function(component) {
    const color = this.getComponentColor(component.type);
    return `<span class="ngss-badge ${color}-badge">${component.title}</span>`;
  },
  
  // Generate progress bar with appropriate color
  createProgressBar: function(componentType, percentage) {
    const color = this.getComponentColor(componentType);
    return `
      <div class="progress-container ${color}-progress-bg">
        <div class="progress-fill ${color}-progress-fill" style="width: ${percentage}%"></div>
      </div>
    `;
  }
};

    "undoCapability": "ability to revise and reconsider responses"
  }
};

/* 
==================================================================================
BACKEND ENGINEERING FUNCTIONALITY
==================================================================================
*/

class CurriculumGeneratorEngine {
  constructor() {
    this.templates = new TemplateLibrary();
    this.validator = new SchemaValidator();
    this.calculator = new ChunkerCalculator();
    this.promptBuilder = new AIPromptBuilder();
  }

  // PRIMARY GENERATION PIPELINE
  async generateCurriculum(userInput) {
    try {
      // 1. Input Validation & Sanitization
      const validatedInput = await this.validator.validateUserInput(userInput);
      
      // 2. Template Selection & Configuration
      const selectedTemplates = await this.templates.selectOptimalTemplates(validatedInput);
      
      // 3. Chunk Calculation & Time Allocation
      const timeAllocation = this.calculator.calculateChunkDistribution(validatedInput);
      
      // 4. Element Assembly & NGSS Mapping
      const assembledElements = await this.assembleElements(validatedInput, selectedTemplates);
      
      // 5. Research Brief Structure Generation
      const researchBriefStructure = this.buildResearchBriefStructure(assembledElements, timeAllocation);
      
      // 6. AI Prompt Generation
      const aiPrompts = this.promptBuilder.generateOptimizedPrompts(researchBriefStructure);
      
      // 7. Output Package Creation
      return this.packageOutput(researchBriefStructure, aiPrompts);
      
    } catch (error) {
      return this.handleGenerationError(error);
    }
  }

  // CORE ALGORITHMS
  assembleElements(userInput, templates) {
    // Algorithm for optimal element selection and sequencing
    const elementsBySection = {
      forecast: [],
      blueprint: [], 
      reflection: []
    };

    userInput.elements.forEach(element => {
      const template = templates.find(t => t.practice === element.practice);
      const assembledElement = {
        ...element,
        template: template,
        scaffolding: this.generateScaffolding(element),
        assessment: this.generateAssessmentCriteria(element),
        connections: this.findCrossCurricularConnections(element)
      };
      
      elementsBySection[element.section].push(assembledElement);
    });

    return this.optimizeElementSequencing(elementsBySection);
  }

  optimizeElementSequencing(elementsBySection) {
    // Dependency resolution algorithm
    // Ensures logical progression and prerequisite satisfaction
    Object.keys(elementsBySection).forEach(section => {
      elementsBySection[section] = this.sortByDependencies(elementsBySection[section]);
    });
    
    return elementsBySection;
  }
}

class ChunkerCalculator {
  constructor() {
    this.MINUTES_PER_CHUNK = 15;
    this.DEFAULT_PERIODS_PER_WEEK = 5;
    this.DEFAULT_MINUTES_PER_PERIOD = 50;
  }

  calculateChunkDistribution(input) {
    const totalAvailableChunks = this.calculateTotalChunks(input);
    const researchChunks = Math.floor(totalAvailableChunks * 0.6); // 60% research
    const practiceChunks = Math.floor(totalAvailableChunks * 0.4); // 40% practice
    
    return {
      total: totalAvailableChunks,
      research: researchChunks,
      practice: practiceChunks,
      distribution: this.distributeAcrossSections(researchChunks),
      timeline: this.generateWeeklyTimeline(input.totalWeeks, totalAvailableChunks)
    };
  }

  calculateTotalChunks(input) {
    const chunksPerWeek = (input.periodsPerWeek * input.minutesPerPeriod) / this.MINUTES_PER_CHUNK;
    return Math.floor(chunksPerWeek * input.totalWeeks);
  }

  validateChunkAllocation(elements) {
    // Ensures chunk allocations are realistic and don't exceed available time
    const totalAllocated = elements.reduce((sum, element) => sum + element.chunkCount, 0);
    const recommendations = [];
    
    if (totalAllocated > this.maxRecommendedChunks) {
      recommendations.push({
        type: 'warning',
        message: 'Total chunk allocation exceeds recommended maximum',
        suggestion: 'Consider reducing chunk counts or extending unit duration'
      });
    }
    
    return { valid: totalAllocated <= this.maxRecommendedChunks, recommendations };
  }
}

class AIPromptBuilder {
  constructor() {
    this.promptTemplates = new Map();
    this.loadPromptTemplates();
  }

  generateOptimizedPrompts(curriculumStructure) {
    const systemPrompt = this.buildSystemPrompt(curriculumStructure);
    const elementPrompts = this.buildElementSpecificPrompts(curriculumStructure);
    const assessmentPrompts = this.buildAssessmentPrompts(curriculumStructure);
    
    return {
      system: systemPrompt,
      elements: elementPrompts,
      assessments: assessmentPrompts,
      validation: this.buildValidationPrompts(curriculumStructure)
    };
  }

  buildSystemPrompt(structure) {
    return `
You are an expert curriculum designer specializing in phenomenon-driven, NGSS-aligned education. 

CURRICULUM CONTEXT:
- Course: ${structure.courseInfo.title}
- Narrative Voice: ${structure.courseInfo.narrativeVoice}
- Phenomenon: ${structure.anchoringPhenomenon.title}
- Driving Question: ${structure.anchoringPhenomenon.drivingQuestion}
- Primary Lens: ${structure.ngssAlignment.primaryCrosscuttingConcept.title}

GENERATION REQUIREMENTS:
1. Create research brief sections that build on each other logically
2. Integrate metacognitive prompts that connect learning across sections
3. Ensure chunk allocations are realistic and practical
4. Maintain the specified narrative voice throughout
5. Apply the crosscutting concept lens consistently

OUTPUT FORMAT:
Generate three separate Google Doc templates (Forecast, Blueprint, Reflection) with:
- Task checklists with time estimates
- Embedded NGSS practice activities
- Metacognitive reflection points
- Learning inventory tables
- Clear assessment criteria
    `;
  }
}

/* 
==================================================================================
DATA PERSISTENCE & API ENDPOINTS
==================================================================================
*/

const apiEndpoints = {
  // GENERATION ENDPOINTS
  "POST /api/curriculum/generate": {
    description: "Generate complete curriculum from user input",
    handler: "CurriculumGeneratorEngine.generateCurriculum()",
    input: "UserCurriculumConfiguration",
    output: "GeneratedCurriculumPackage"
  },
  
  "POST /api/prompts/generate": {
    description: "Generate AI prompts for existing curriculum",
    handler: "AIPromptBuilder.generateOptimizedPrompts()",
    input: "CurriculumStructure", 
    output: "AIPromptPackage"
  },

  // VALIDATION ENDPOINTS
  "POST /api/validate/chunks": {
    description: "Validate chunk allocation and timing",
    handler: "ChunkerCalculator.validateChunkAllocation()",
    input: "ElementChunkConfiguration",
    output: "ValidationResults"
  },

  "POST /api/validate/schema": {
    description: "Validate curriculum JSON against schema",
    handler: "SchemaValidator.validateCurriculumStructure()",
    input: "CurriculumJSON",
    output: "SchemaValidationResults"
  },

  // TEMPLATE ENDPOINTS
  "GET /api/templates/elements": {
    description: "Get available element templates by NGSS practice",
    handler: "TemplateLibrary.getElementsByPractice()",
    output: "ElementTemplateLibrary"
  },

  "GET /api/templates/phenomena": {
    description: "Get curated phenomenon examples by subject",
    handler: "PhenomenaLibrary.getPhenomenaBySubject()",
    output: "PhenomenaTemplateLibrary"
  },

  // FILE OPERATIONS
  "POST /api/export/json": {
    description: "Export curriculum as downloadable JSON",
    handler: "FileExporter.exportAsJSON()",
    input: "CurriculumStructure",
    output: "DownloadableFile"
  },

  "POST /api/export/prompts": {
    description: "Export AI prompts as text files",
    handler: "FileExporter.exportPromptsAsText()",
    input: "AIPromptPackage", 
    output: "DownloadableFile"
  }
};

/* 
==================================================================================
ERROR HANDLING & QUALITY ASSURANCE
==================================================================================
*/

class QualityAssuranceEngine {
  static validateCurriculumQuality(generatedCurriculum) {
    const qualityChecks = [
      this.checkNGSSAlignment(generatedCurriculum),
      this.checkChunkRealism(generatedCurriculum), 
      this.checkPhenomenonConnection(generatedCurriculum),
      this.checkAssessmentAlignment(generatedCurriculum),
      this.checkMetacognitiveProgramming(generatedCurriculum)
    ];

    const overallScore = qualityChecks.reduce((sum, check) => sum + check.score, 0) / qualityChecks.length;
    
    return {
      overallScore,
      checks: qualityChecks,
      recommendations: this.generateImprovementRecommendations(qualityChecks)
    };
  }

  static checkNGSSAlignment(curriculum) {
    // Validates that all elements properly map to NGSS practices
    // and consistently apply crosscutting concepts
    return {
      category: "NGSS Alignment",
      score: 0.95,
      details: "All elements properly mapped to practices",
      issues: []
    };
  }
}

console.log("Mock Data Tree:", JSON.stringify(mockCurriculumData, null, 2));
